resultMethods.correlations_main: National obesity correlations: 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 state-cluster bootstrap resamples. Saved p-values are conventional county-level tests, not cluster-adjusted.
resultMethods.ols_ladders: National age-adjusted obesity OLS/WLS with HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors (not state-clustered). Complete-case samples may change by specification. Detection-fraction coefficients span 0 to 1; log10 coefficients describe a tenfold concentration change.
resultMethods.state_level: Within-state UCMR5 detection-fraction / age-adjusted obesity Spearman correlations; at least 12 complete counties. Intervals use approximate Fisher z, not the national cluster bootstrap. No multiple-testing correction.
resultMethods.correlations_diabetes: National crude diabetes correlations. No bootstrap intervals were calculated; saved p-values are conventional county-level tests.
resultMethods.texas_obesity: Texas age-adjusted obesity correlations. No bootstrap intervals were calculated; these compare different data and periods with the published study.
resultMethods.texas_diabetes: Texas crude diabetes correlations. No bootstrap intervals were calculated.
resultMethods.concordance: Pairwise-complete source comparisons. Spearman correlations compare ranks; their squares do not quantify variance explained in the original concentrations.
resultMethods.sensitivity: Unweighted age-adjusted obesity Spearman correlations for predefined sensitivity subsets. No bootstrap intervals or multiple-testing correction.
resultMethods.usgs_nd_sensitivity: USGS nondetect substitution changed from 0.9 to 0.5 µg/L; unweighted age-adjusted obesity Spearman correlation.
resultMethods.artefact_checks: Age-adjusted obesity OLS with HC3 errors: sample-count control and a detects-only restriction. The saved detects-only restriction used the original has_detect indicator, including its fractional CT crosswalk values.
resultMethods.negative_control_corr: Saved comparator correlations with age-adjusted obesity. Labels negative/positive control are the original analysis labels, not proof of causal validity. No bootstrap intervals.
resultMethods.negative_control_ols: Saved comparator OLS with HC3 errors, not state-clustered errors. Statistical adjustment does not establish causality.
